concept.hr: Prizemni i prostorni val se zbrajaju; dok se faza mijenja, signal jača i slabi
concept.en: Ground and sky wave add up; as their phase drifts, the signal swells and fades

summary.hr: Prizemni i prostorni val istog odašiljača zbrajaju se. Ionosfera pomiče njihovu faznu razliku, pa signal koleba; feding je najdublji kad su valovi jednako jaki.
summary.en: Ground and sky wave of one transmitter add up. The ionosphere shifts their phase difference, so the signal swings; fades are deepest when both waves match.

what.hr: Aplet fading_applet.html (prostorni i prizemni val s klizačima amplitude i faze, i njihov zbroj) i tekst odjeljka o fedingu (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet fading_applet.html (sky wave and ground wave with amplitude and phase sliders, and their sum) and the text of the fading section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan bez vanjskih biblioteka, preveden na engleski, dodani jakost signala kroz vrijeme, pomicanje ionosfere, raspon i dubina fedinga, predlošci i objašnjenje
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn without outside libraries, translated into English, the signal strength over time, a moving ionosphere, the fade's range and depth, presets and an explanation added
